body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes CI failures stemming from missing/ambiguous exports by making `HttpMethod` available to API consumers and removing a naming collision in the external lookup tests.

**Changes:**
- Re-export `HttpMethod` from `packages/spec/src/api/router.zod.ts` so it’s available via `@objectstack/spec/api`.
- Update `external-lookup.test.ts` to use `ExternalFieldMappingSchema` / `ExternalFieldMapping` instead of the ambiguous `FieldMappingSchema` / `FieldMapping`.
- Add generated JSON Schema output for `HttpMethod` and introduce a new docs page under `references/api`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/data/external-lookup.test.ts | Avoids `FieldMappingSchema` naming ambiguity by using the external-lookup-specific schema/type. |
| packages/spec/src/api/router.zod.ts | Re-exports `HttpMethod` for downstream imports from `@objectstack/spec/api`. |
| packages/spec/json-schema/api/HttpMethod.json | Adds the JSON Schema artifact for `HttpMethod`. |
| content/docs/references/api/view.mdx | Adds documentation for `HttpMethod` under the API docs section (but currently has inconsistencies). |

The referenced source file `packages/spec/src/api/view.zod.ts` does not exist in this repo (the `HttpMethod` schema is defined in `packages/spec/src/shared/http.zod.ts`). This makes the doc misleading and hard to trace.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/shared/http.zod.ts`
```

This doc page is named and titled "View", but its content documents `HttpMethod` only. Consider renaming the page (and frontmatter/title) to match the schema being documented, or expanding the content to actually cover the API "View" protocol.
```suggestion
title: HttpMethod
description: HTTP method schema
---

# HttpMethod
```
